dynamic_objectives: GA/GGA server_only; BFD-GA total, as stored in base configurations.
budget_objective: total server+UPS power for all methods; explicitly overridden in frozen ResearchBudgetBenchmark.java.
measurement: One JVM per date/profile, serial solves after the dynamic pool has completed. Each method warmup=2 generations, seed7. Methods shuffled per seed; budget order is generations,evaluations,time. Not a JIT steady-state guarantee.
time_scope: Includes BFD preprocessing, initialization and solver; excludes trace loading, warmup and independent final-power recomputation. Full-population checkpoints can overrun; solve_ns and overrun_ns retained.
evaluation_scope: Counts candidate score calls, including elite rescoring; excludes feasibility and final validation.
search_spaces: BFD-GA retains fixed BFD groups; same objective/budget does not imply identical search spaces.
